sentences.text: Yes, the documents support stating that no foreclosure charge applies to individual borrowers on floating rate loans for non-business purposes.

The RBI direction states that, for existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before December 31, 2025 for purposes other than business to individual borrowers with or without co-obligant(s), a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.
The documents do not state the sanction_date for the loan.

missing.searched: Looked for the loan sanction date in the provided evidence and rule findings.
